**ctu-cz** is a project in [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md). Its code is written mainly in [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md) (99.9 %), with [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [Rust](@/glossary/rust.md) and [Makefile](@/glossary/makefile.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created on 24 April 2020; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 15 May 2020. It reads “Update README.md”. With no commit in the last 48 months it is listed as archive: work from 2020, kept for the record and dated as measured.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/ctu-cz).

Related work in [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md): [czech-stats](@/work/czech-stats.md) (2020), [gooddata-graphql](@/work/gooddata-graphql.md) (2016), [microcrawler-browser](@/work/microcrawler-browser.md) (2016) and [apollo-crawler-extension](@/work/apollo-crawler-extension.md) (2013–2016).
